tools.name: get_company_facts
tools.description: Who Kratons is: legal identity, address, contact channels, countries served, languages, services, pricing policy and how to request a proposal. Read-only.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Countries and cities where Kratons currently offers tours or tickets, with counts. Read-only.

tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Tours and tickets Kratons operates, filtered by country, city and free text. Returns name, type, city, country, category, duration, free-cancellation flag and a summary — never prices or suppliers (Kratons quotes one package price per trip).

tools.name: list_sample_itineraries
tools.description: Published sample itineraries Kratons operates (name, destination, duration, category, summary, day-by-day outline) to start a conversation from. Never prices or suppliers — every trip is quoted as one package price by a human advisor.

tools.name: get_proposal_request_status
tools.description: Where a submitted proposal request stands (received, being prepared, proposal sent, confirmed, closed), looked up by the reference returned when it was submitted. Returns the stage, dates and the reply commitment; no personal data.

tools.name: how_to_request_a_proposal
tools.description: The checklist a traveller or agent should send to Kratons to receive a bespoke proposal, the pricing policy, and how a human advisor follows up. Read-only.

tools.name: request_a_proposal
tools.description: Submit a structured proposal request to Kratons on behalf of a traveller or a travel agent: contact, destinations within Spain/Portugal/Morocco, dates, travellers, total budget, interests. Returns a reference. A human advisor replies by e-mail — there is no automatic booking, no online checkout and

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_destinations, search_experiences · Private data: get_company_facts, request_a_proposal · Public sink: how_to_request_a_proposal, request_a_proposal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_destinations, search_experiences · Private data: get_company_facts, request_a_proposal · Public sink: how_to_request_a_proposal, request_a_proposal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
